title: Giraffe dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#3a2a5a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='36' y='72' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d9a520' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d9a520' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='35' y='86' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='55' y='84' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='63' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='3.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='56' r='3' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='66' r='3' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>

  <!-- raised arm (dancing!) -->
  <rect x='60' y='48' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f5c542' transform='rotate(30 63 56)'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>

  <!-- other arm -->
  <rect x='28' y='56' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5c542' transform='rotate(-25 31 63)'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='55' r='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='41' y='30' width='10' height='26' rx='5' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='25' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='27' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f0b030'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='27' r='1' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='1' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M33 30 Q36 33 41 31' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='43' y='13' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#d9a520'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='12' r='3' fill='#c47a1a'/>
  <rect x='50' y='14' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#d9a520'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='13' r='3' fill='#c47a1a'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='20' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b030' transform='rotate(-20 55 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='19' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#f0b030' transform='rotate(20 36 19)'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#2b2b2b'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='23.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M65 60 Q74 58 73 50' stroke='#d9a520' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='49' r='3' fill='#c47a1a'/>

  <!-- dancing sparkles -->
  <path d='M82 30 l2 -5 l2 5 l-5 2 l5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 z' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <path d='M15 42 l1.5 -3.5 l1.5 3.5 l-3.5 1.5 l3.5 1.5 l-1.5 3.5 l-1.5 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ff9ecb'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='65' r='2' fill='#9ee6ff'/>
</svg>
